Thank you for opening here... we've missed good chilli crab! Cheese was awesome too.
Dec 2021
We've tried some other Singaporean chilli crabs in Saigon, and finally decided to try Jumbo's when we were doing our staycay opposite the restaurant.

Main reasons why they won our hearts (and bellies!):

- the sauce is definitely much more flavorful, intense, and less starchy than others. Once you started having it, you find it hard to stop. We ordered takeaway and they were generous to give one big delicious piping hot bowl of it!

- ordered cheese crab for the kids, and they almost licked the entire bowl clean with their bread

- their crabs were truly fresh, bouncy and juicy... and even though they cost a whole lot more than other restaurants, but the quality of their crab was far more superior. Additionally, the taste of their chilli sauce had truly penetrated each and every part of the crab, unlike other places where it felt like the chilli sauce was just a "pour over", like a lazy afterthought

- we got the promotional deal of getting a serving of free cereal prawns with an order of any two crabs - and though free - the cereal prawns were packed with a full punch of the right Singaporean flavours... and similarly, a generous serving of those incredibly addictive cereals that went along so well with the crispy yet amazingly juicy prawns.

Hope they keep it up!

The Place For Even The Pickiest Eaters
Jan 2019 • Family
Two weeks ago, we went to this wonderful restaurant called the Jumbo Restaurant. This particular day, we were very excited, because Jumbo recently Opened a new restaurant in HCMC, and luckily, we got a chance to go there. Since we knew this was one of the best seafood restaurants, we reserved a table as soon as we could, and went there afterwards. As soon as we went in the restaurant, I could see that they put a lot of effort into the interior. There were different types of wine inside those transparent glass containers, different types of fishes and crustaceans greeting us, and big chandeliers with bright lights hanging from the ceiling. The service was good as well. The staff members kindly greeted us when we arrived, and led us to a clean table. Every time we finished a dish, they brought us a new clean one, and they even brought those napkins and lemon water for us to stay clean. Even those tiny details, like the lighting and the temperature of the room was perfect. The room was chill compared to the outside weather, yet not too cold. The lighting was in a bright orange, which added to the mood. 
The food at Jumbo Seafood was above expectations. As we could see in the fish tanks, they had very fresh ingredients and also had delicious yet unique sauces that spiced up their food. The first one that we ordered was the deep fried prawns. I don’t know how but they managed to make the deep fried cover spicy/sweet, which adds more to the “unique” part. The second and third ones that we ordered were the main dishes, which were the two types of crab dishes, the chili crab and the pepper crab. Both ones tasted Outstanding with a bit of spice to it, and even though I’m not a big fan of pepper, I really liked the sauce. The crab was a monster, it was 4~5 times as big as a normal crab, and it was extremely fat. Also, the two types of sauces were very unique, it was something I’ve never tasted before, each with a great combination with the other side dishes and the ingredients. It was quite obvious on why it was the best selling dish and the main dish of the restaurant at the same time. I have a feeling that I should also add the parts that weren’t that pleasant, but it was highly outweighed when compared to the good parts. Those are some irritating parts that kind of annoyed me during the meal, but still didn’t ruined my experience. The bad parts include the small table, drink choice and the price. The drinks served were tea, and we didn’t have the option to change it to either a cold one or just water. The price wasn’t low as well, the drinks were 2~3 times as expensive as the ones outside, and the price of the food was nothing to laugh at. Also, the small table made it easier to spill food or drinks, since the table was way too tiny to serve a family of 3. The sauce made it worse, since it has a LOT of spices and the color was either pitch black or red. Although there were some parts that was really annoying for me, but this is still the best restaurant I’ve ever been to in my life. The combinations between the different types of dishes plus the sauces were amazing, and even the service was perfect. Every bit of the restaurant was way above our expectations. Although the price was pretty high and the eating process was a bit messy(all those sauces and bits), it’s totally worth it. I’ll most likely come back in the future and will gladly recommend it to my friends and family.

Worth the heavy bill...
Oct 2018 • Friends
Comparing to the branch in Singapore Riverside, the one in hcmc is more upscale, hence higher price (Alaskan king crab is priced at sgd 250/kg). In a country where the cost of living is lower than singapore, this could be the reason why the restaurant was not very crowded.
Everything was however impeccable, from the welcome service at the ground floor, the decoration to the nice waiters. 
Most importantly, the quality of the food makes this restaurant one of the best in the city. We equally enjoyed all the plates we ordered, from the black pepper crab to the simple sea food fried rice. 
I will definitely recommend it to those who can afford a heavy bill.
